pictures.author: Terragio67
pictures.observations: Whole500x606 standing fortress on exposed pale cliff: tall polygonal keep with projecting row of rounded corbel arches, crenellated outer crown and smaller tile-roofed top cabin. Lower cream-gray stone curtain/rectangular windows/crenels, left hipped tile-roofed annex, right gate/steps and a narrow chimney/bell-like stack. Panorama processing disclosed by photographer; used for shape, not metric survey.

pictures.author: Acediscovery
pictures.observations: Closer960x703 view: stone curtain has five sparse rectangular grilled windows, broad rectangular merlons/some narrow slits, weathered pale limestone courses. Tall polygonal shaft is mostly blind with a few small square slots. Projected machicolation band has deep rounded arch mouths and tapered corbel piers; raised rectangular upper cabin under a small brown tile hip roof, corner crown merlons and thin masts. Low left annex is roofed. Original simplified stone/trim/slit vocabulary rather than copied cracks or pixel atlas.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing Cesta/De La Fratta fortress: mapped irregular lower stone enclosure/occupied court, sparse recessed grilled windows and real recessed arched closed gate/short approach treads. Tall pentagonal keep, projected rounded machicolation mouths/corbel piers, crenellated upper crown and small tile-roofed top cabin. Two low map-associated roofed wings, restrained chimney/slits/roof edging, locally bounded faceted limestone outcrop contacting unchanged coarse DEM. Original shared-material geometry and four browser levels. No copied stone-crack/coat-of-arms atlas, museum collection/furnished rooms, temporary visitors/masts/ropes or other independent buildings/whole ridge.
